title: Moving the data directory: adopt the old base, verify before deleting it
trigger: When moving or renaming DD's data directory, or deciding whether an old DD data directory can be deleted
behavior_delta: Add the previous location to the bases adoptHistory searches in src/store/adopt.js in the same change. Before deleting an old data directory, open its index.sqlite read-only with node:sqlite (no sqlite3 CLI on this machine) and compare its memory_atoms topic_keys with .dd/atoms/; delete it only when every topic_key already exists there, and only after the user confirms.
what: Add the previous location to the bases adoptHistory searches in src/store/adopt.js in the same change. Before deleting an old data directory, open its index.sqlite read-only with node:sqlite (no sqlite3 CLI on this machine) and compare its memory_atoms topic_keys with .dd/atoms/; delete it only when every topic_key already exists there, and only after the user confirms.
why: The data directory moved three times (~/.supermem, ~/.dd, ~/.dd-data). Adoption is list-driven, so a move without updating the list silently abandons telemetry, observations and the contradiction log while atoms return from git and the store still looks complete. The 2026-09-19 cleanup confirmed the topic_key comparison is enough to tell an old directory holds nothing unmigrated.

evidence_refs.summary: previousDataDirs and adoptHistory adopt history only from the listed candidate directories.
openStore passes previousDataDirs candidates to adoptHistory when the index is fresh.
